title: "1 Thessalonians"
---

# 1 Thessalonians

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

1 Thessalonians encourages believers to remain faithful while awaiting Christ's return, living with hope, holiness, and perseverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">1 Thessalonians 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Work of faith, labor of love</div>

### Why This Verse

Christian maturity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter commends the Thessalonian believers for their faith, love, and hope. The key verse highlights their example of genuine conversion and faithful witness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">1 Thessalonians 2:13</div>

<div class="identifier">The word of God effectually worketh</div>

### Why This Verse

Authority of Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Paul's ministry among the Thessalonians. The key verse emphasizes sincere, sacrificial service motivated by love rather than personal gain.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">1 Thessalonians 3:12</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lord make you increase in love</div>

### Why This Verse

Prayer and growth

### Chapter Insight

This chapter expresses Paul's concern for their spiritual growth and perseverance. The key verse highlights the importance of strengthening believers in times of trial.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">1 Thessalonians 4:16</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lord Himself shall descend from heaven</div>

### Why This Verse

Major rapture/resurrection passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches holy living, brotherly love, and Christ's return. The key verse provides comfort regarding believers who have died before Christ's coming.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">1 Thessalonians 5:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Pray without ceasing</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the shortest and most quoted commands

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses the Day of the Lord and practical Christian living. The key verse encourages believers to remain spiritually alert, faithful, and joyful while awaiting Christ's return.
:::
